canonical_title: Cylinder head temperature indicating system for air-cooled engines

versions.title_at_revision: Cylinder head temperature indicating system for air-cooled engines.
versions.text:
A cylinder head temperature

indicator shall be provided for each engine on airplanes equipped with cowl flaps. In the case of airplanes which do not have cowl flaps, an indicator shall be provided if compliance with the provisions of § 3.581 is demonstrated at a speed in excess of the speed of best rate of climb.
